# Tulum Properties

> An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Tulum, Mexico, covering their backgrounds, areas of activity and official websites.

Tulum Properties is an independent editorial directory about real estate developers in Tulum, Mexico. It is not a real estate agency or broker, does not sell property and is not affiliated with the companies it profiles. Each profile links to the developer's official website.

## Key facts
- Website: https://tulum.properties/
- Topic: Residential real estate developers active in Tulum, Mexico
- Developers profiled: Inmobilia, SIMCA, TAO México, Grupo R4 Yucatán
- Contact: editor@tulum.properties

## Developer profiles
- [Inmobilia](https://tulum.properties/developers/inmobilia/): A Mérida-based developer of large planned communities whose Tulum presence centres on Tulum 101, a master-planned district of residential, hospitality and mixed-use projects. Official website: https://www.inmobilia.mx/
- [SIMCA](https://tulum.properties/developers/simca/): A southeast-Mexico developer with residential, industrial and retail divisions, active in Tulum through condominium projects in Aldea Zamá, La Veleta and the Tulum 101 master plan. Official website: https://simca.mx/
- [TAO México](https://tulum.properties/developers/tao-mexico/): TAO México is a Riviera Maya-born developer of residential communities, with completed and ongoing projects in Tulum, Akumal and Puerto Aventuras and newer work in Puerto Vallarta and Los Cabos. Official website: https://taoméxico.com/en/
- [Grupo R4 Yucatán](https://tulum.properties/developers/grupo-r4/): A Yucatán Peninsula developer with residential projects in Yucatán and Quintana Roo, including three condominium buildings in Tulum's Aldea Zamá area. Official website: https://grupor4yucatan.mx/

## Projects mentioned
- Tulum 101 by Inmobilia (Tulum, Quintana Roo): Master-planned community (macro-lots)
- Nido by Tulum 101 by Inmobilia (Tulum 101, Tulum): Gated community of single-family lots
- Ramia by Tulum 101 by Inmobilia (Tulum 101, Tulum): Residential lots
- 101 Park by Inmobilia (Tulum 101, Tulum): Condominium community
- Humana Tulum by Inmobilia (Tulum 101, Tulum): Mixed-use (residences and hotel)
- Mayaliah Tulum MGallery by Inmobilia (Tulum): Branded residences and boutique hotel
- Faena Residences Tulum by Inmobilia (Tulum): Branded residences
- Costa Caribe by SIMCA (Aldea Zamá, Tulum): Condominiums
- Gran Tulum by SIMCA (Tulum 101, Tulum): Condominiums
- Natal by SIMCA (La Veleta, Tulum): Condominiums
- Querido Tulum by SIMCA (Tulum): Condominiums (completed)
- Edena Tulum by TAO México (Tulum): Homes & condominiums
- TAO Tulum by TAO México (Aldea Zamá, Tulum): Residential community
- Santamar & Santamar Prime by TAO México (Akumal): Beachfront condominiums
- Sek Akumal by TAO by TAO México (Akumal): Condominiums
- TAO Náutico by TAO México (Puerto Aventuras): Waterfront condominiums
- Joy Tree Akumal by TAO México (Akumal): Residential lots
- TAO Blue Gardens by TAO México (Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco): Condominiums & bungalows
- Monte Rocella by TAO México (Los Cabos, Baja California Sur): Condominiums
- Carey Tulum Condos by Grupo R4 Yucatán (Aldea Zamá (Selvazama master plan), Tulum): Condominiums
- Cautiva by Grupo R4 Yucatán (Aldea Zamá, Tulum): Condominiums with commercial area
- Déjà Vu by Grupo R4 Yucatán (Aldea Zamá (Selvazama master plan), Tulum): Residences in two towers
- Altra Beach Condos by Grupo R4 Yucatán (Playa del Carmen): Condominiums
- Olaya by Grupo R4 Yucatán (Playa del Carmen): Condominiums
